actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The repository is a ROS2 + Gazebo + MuJoCo workspace for simulating and walking quadruped robots
The README identifies Go2 as the only fully working robot
The Python requirements include gymnasium 0.29 or newer and mujoco 3.0 or newer
The MuJoCo environment points SCENE_XML at training/envs/go2_scene.xml
Go2MujocoEnv is the Gymnasium environment class the training code constructs
Go2MujocoEnv loads the MJCF with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path and builds the data with mujoco.MjData
Go2MujocoEnv sets model.opt.timestep to SIM_DT
SIM_DT is 0.005 s and CTRL_DECIMATION is 4, so one policy step is 0.02 s
ACT_DIM is 19
The action space is a Box from -1.0 to 1.0 with one element per action dimension
The step writes the control vector to data.ctrl and calls mujoco.mj_step once per decimation step
The parkour scene sets the integration time step to 0.005 s in its option element
The floating base body starts at 0 0 0.42 and carries the root free joint
The arm and two-finger gripper add seven joints after the twelve leg joints and must stay the last child of base
The scene declares nineteen position actuators, one per leg, arm and gripper joint, each with a ctrlrange
The four hip actuators have ctrlrange -1.0472 to 1.0472
The front thigh actuators have ctrlrange -1.5708 to 3.4907 and the rear thigh actuators -0.5236 to 4.5379
The four calf actuators have ctrlrange -2.7227 to -0.83776
The five arm joints have ctrlrange -1.5708 to 1.5708 and the two finger joints 0 to 0.025 and -0.025 to 0
The parkour hurdles and platforms are parked at z -5 by default and the parkour environment rewrites their position and size at reset

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates the MJCF deterministically from the reset state and the served model has no random element, so one ctrl sequence and tick count repeat a trajectory; the bridge takes no seed input and a reset restores the model defaults, so no seed selects a different one.  The package's fake backend is deterministic too, but its placeholder motion is not the engine's physics.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the scene's MJCF, takes the nineteen actuator control ranges, the joint dimensions and the option time step from that tree, then moves each actuated joint toward its ctrl target at a placeholder rate; it computes no inertia, torque, contact, friction, actuator, sensor or noise dynamics, so no trajectory here is a MuJoCo result

the stand-in resolves no mesh, height field, contact, equality or sensor constraint: the parkour hurdles, the floor and the Go2's collision geoms are not simulated physically, and the robot cannot stand or walk in the fake
the stand-in does not apply the model's damping, armature, joint range, actuator gain or bias parameters; it treats every position actuator as a direct target for its joint

the card's models[0] is served, training/envs/go2_parkour_scene.xml, while the upstream entry class loads training/envs/go2_scene.xml (go2_mujoco_env.py:11); both carry the same robot, arm and actuator block, but the flat training scene is not served

the parkour obstacles are parked at z -5 in the file and the parkour environment rewrites them at reset (go2_parkour_scene.xml:15-20); this driver serves the file as written and does not rewrite the terrain
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine

the upstream observation vector (76 values, go2_mujoco_env.py:70), reward, curriculum, domain randomisation and rendering are not part of the cap.world.* contract served here; the state carries only time, qpos, qvel and ctrl
snapshot and restore use the bridge's fallback copy of time, qpos, qvel and ctrl because the stand-in has no mj_getState or mj_setState; a restore is not the engine's full integration state
no physical Go2 is modelled and nothing was validated against the hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation is held: after an e-stop the runtime refuses every step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the model data stays readable
